data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 5.2m (2016: surplus of GBP 0.8m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
specific_events: Investment group life contract underwriting issues (2016)

prior_year_events.event_name: UNFCU group life policy licensing breach
prior_year_events.impact_description: Licensing breach discovered which created an estimated actuarial liability that was booked on the 2016 year of account and contributed to adverse reserve development.

prior_year_events.event_name: Investment group life contract (mandatory group scheme) underwriting issues
prior_year_events.impact_description: Mandatory group scheme turned out not to be mandatory, producing much higher sales volume and an unexpired risks provision and adverse claims expectations (reserved at ~200% loss ratio on forecast premium).

named_events.event_name: UNFCU group life policy licensing breach
named_events.loss_description: Estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7m booked on the 2016 year of account (subsequently signed forward into 2018).

named_events.event_name: Investment group life contract (mandatory group scheme)
named_events.loss_description: Contract reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200% on a forecast ultimate premium net of commissions (unexpired risks provision recognised).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 10.925m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded net adverse prior-year development (a deficit) driven by adverse claims development primarily on long-term/group life business and specific underwriting issues (notably a material actuarial liability arising from the UNFCU group life licensing breach and an investment group life contract). Using the gross claims development table (excluding the two most recent underwriting years) results in an aggregate gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 2.4m (about 22% of opening gross reserves).
raw_causal_phrases: increase in claims frequency on key binders
licencing breach on a group life policy
recognition of an unexpired risks provision of GBP 8.6m
establishment of an additional expense reserve of GBP 1.1m
deficit of GBP 5.2m ... relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the long-term business provision reconciliation (At 1 January) = GBP 10,925k (10.925m). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior years' line was present; prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2016) and summing diagonal changes for 2011-2015, yielding +2.4m (strengthening). The document also reports a net deficit of GBP 5.2m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-derived figure; where only net figures existed they were not used as primary. Some event-specific provisions (UNFCU GBP 7.7m and unexpired risks GBP 8.6m) materially affect 2017 provisions and have been noted. Page references are approximate to the locations where figures and narrative appear in the report.
